Method of Attack: Ransomware attacks targeting multiple industry sectors
Exploitation of Zerologon (CVE-2020-1472) vulnerability for Windows privilege escalation
Hacking into external-facing remote services (e.g., VPNs) using stolen credentials
Discoverer: US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS)
Attack Vector: Compromised external-facing remote services (VPNs) without Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom notes (e.g., as reported by BleepingComputer)
